svg.title: One backup, two tiers, then a restore
svg.desc: Each backup of vm-backup, daily at 23:00 UTC or on Backup now, first takes a snapshot, kept a day in rg-lab-az104-19-backup-irp1 and ready within minutes, then copies it into rsv-lab, which keeps 7 daily recovery points. A restore to a new VM stages through the stage account and must land in rg-lab-az104-19-backup.
